subject: Interim status — delayed payloads affecting hosted inference (us-west)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@atlasmed.com>, ops@atlasmed.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interim status — delayed payloads affecting hosted inference (us-west)

Hi Claire / AtlasMed ops team,

I wanted to give you an immediate interim update: between ~08:38–10:45 PT we observed elevated end-to-end request latency and a higher-than-normal rate of delayed payloads (partial or stalled responses) for requests routed to our us-west hosted inference pool. Impact for most customers was increased p95/p99 and a small number of truncated/partial responses. Your account appears to have experienced ~0.8% increased retry rate correlated with the same window.

What we know so far:
- Root trigger: a partial KV cache eviction cascade on a subset of inference nodes during an internal cache compaction.
- Impact window: ~2026-03-22T15:38Z to 2026-03-22T17:45Z (local: 08:38–10:45 PT).
- Affected surface: hosted text-generation and streaming responses originating from us-west region.

Immediate mitigation actions taken:
- We routed production traffic away from the impacted node pool to a healthy pool (completed at 09:22 PT).
- Temporary increase in batch timeout to reduce partial-output truncation while we validate KV cache stability.
- Throttled low-priority background prefetch jobs to reduce load on the control-plane.

Current status: service is operating within expected bounds for most customers; we are continuing monitoring at high alert and collecting detailed traces. We will publish an incident entry on the status page within the hour.

Asks from AtlasMed ops (helpful):
- If you have request IDs or example API payloads that saw truncation, please reply with 2–3 samples (x-request-id header) so we can match traces.
- Confirm if you saw any client-side automatic retries that impacted downstream ordering/processing.

Attachments: incident-brief.pdf (short summary). Full timeline CSV will be shared with the postmortem.

Apologies for the disruption — I know latency noise on inference is disruptive to your pipelines. I'll follow up with a mitigation update as soon as we have confirmation that routing changes are holding.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@atlasmed.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:20:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim status — delayed payloads affecting hosted inference (us-west)

Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick note. Two quick questions:
1) Do you have any estimate for when full normal service will be restored? We’re seeing some retries spike and want to adjust our backoff if needed.
2) Did this affect the dedicated pools or only hosted/shared pools?

Claire
Product Ops, AtlasMed

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@atlasmed.com>, ops@atlasmed.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:38:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interim status — delayed payloads affecting hosted inference (us-west)

Hi Claire — quick answers below, and included an internal note for visibility: 

1) Normal service: our routing cutover completed at ~09:22 PT and initial metrics show p95/p99 returning to baseline across most tenants. We expect to be fully stabilized within the hour pending trace validation. If you’re still seeing persistent retries after 10:30 PT please send the x-request-ids and we’ll prioritize.

2) Scope: only the hosted/shared us-west pool was impacted. Dedicated/reserved pools (including AtlasMed dedicated pools) were not affected by the KV compaction event. We double-checked routing rules before the cutover to avoid moving dedicated traffic.

Internal note for Aditya / Marissa: please keep the incident bridge open until we validate KV cache hit-rate for 1 hour post-cutover. Capture representative request IDs for Claire if they come in. Also prep a short customer-facing timeline CSV and attach to the postmortem.

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@atlasmed.com>, ops@atlasmed.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-incident update and follow-up items — IR-20260322-01

Claire / AtlasMed ops,

Follow-up summary and next steps now that we've closed the initial remediation window: 

Summary:
- Impact window: 2026-03-22T15:38Z -> 2026-03-22T17:45Z (local 08:38–10:45 PT).
- Root cause: an unexpected KV cache compaction schedule kicked a small subset of us-west serving nodes into a higher eviction rate, causing a transient spike in cache misses and increased partial-response cases during heavy concurrent prefetches.
- Mitigation executed: traffic reroute away from impacted nodes, temporary batch timeout increase, and reduction of background prefetch concurrency.
- Current status: no active degradation; p95/p99 in us-west are within SLA target as of 14:50 PT.

What we’re doing next:
- Postmortem & timeline: we attached incident-timeline.csv and published a preliminary postmortem draft to the linked Drive doc (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cIncidentPostmortem). Final postmortem and root-cause analysis will be shared by 2026-03-26.
- Follow-ups for AtlasMed: engineering will provide a set of signed trace samples (x-request-id) per your request if you reply with the IDs you observed. We can also run a replay of the affected request window against a staging snapshot if helpful.
- Preventative changes: change compaction scheduling to stagger across pools, improved KV eviction telemetry, and a safety cutover to prevent simultaneous eviction spikes.

References:
- Status page incident: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IR-20260322-01
- Internal ticket: JIRA-INC-4721

Attachments: incident-timeline.csv (CSV of sample traces and timings), incident-brief.pdf (summary).

If you’d like a short post-incident sync this week (15–30 minutes) I’m happy to schedule.

Thanks again for flagging this quickly — we’ll follow through on the RCA and share mitigations you can expect.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
